text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — I'm assembling a single dashboard (escalation matrix + telemetry) for the new runtime + infra metrics so we can finalize alert rules, oncall routing, and quota signals. Need: metric names + labels we should use, recommended thresholds & windows, which PD service to page, and owner tag for the widget. PR: https://git.redwood/pr/4875

Sean Liu: Thanks — from runtime side the key signals we have already exported: serve_latency_p50, serve_latency_p95, request_error_rate, kv_cache_hit_ratio, batch_size_avg, queue_depth, gpu_utilization_pct, model_load_failures. Tags: model, region, pool, route, customer_tier.

Sean Liu: Suggested thresholds (initial):
- serve_latency_p95 > 1.2s (5m window) -> severity:P1
- request_error_rate > 0.5% (5m) OR sudden spike (x5 baseline in 5m) -> severity:P0
- kv_cache_hit_ratio < 40% (15m) -> severity:P2
- queue_depth > 50 for any pool (1m) -> severity:P1
- gpu_utilization_pct > 95% (10m sustained) -> severity:P1

Priya Radhakrishnan: Two SRE notes:
1) For SLO burn alerts use burn-rate rules: alert if error_budget_burn_rate[5m] > 5x OR sustained burn > 2x for 1h. P0s should be immediate pager to oncall.
2) We should avoid paging on transient p95 blips. Use a short `for:` (2m) + a 1h sustained rule fallback.

Priya Radhakrishnan: Escalation mapping proposal:
- P0: immediate pager to eng-runtime oncall + #incidents. PD service: "runtime-core-pager"
- P1: message in #runtime-ops + oncall if persists > 10m
- P2: channel-only, notify owners (tagged in dashboard)

Alex Gomez: On quotas: we emit quota_exhaustion_count, quota_violation_rate, per_customer_token_usage. Recommend adding an alert: per-customer token usage > 90% of reserved quota for 10m -> page customer-ops team (PD: customer-quotas). Also a cluster-level throttle event when aggregate usage > 80% across pools -> severity:P1.

Jess Kim: UX note — when we roll out new alerts, we'll want canary groups. Suggest we:
- enable alerts for 10% of traffic first (canary)
- monitor false-positive rate against known good prompts
- provide an easy UI control in Console to mute or adjust thresholds per environment

Maya Patel: Good. Two implementation asks:
1) Add `owner` and `pd_service` metadata fields on each widget + a `rollout_stage` tag (canary/stable).
2) Produce example alert YAML for SRE to vet.

infra-bot: Dashboard PR updated: https://git.redwood/pr/4875/files — added widgets for the metrics Sean listed and metadata fields.

Alex Gomez: Example alert snippet for quota (proposal):
```yaml
- name: "quota-high-aggregate"
  expr: sum(rate(per_customer_token_usage[5m])) by (pool) / sum(pool_capacity) by (pool) > 0.8
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: P1
    pd_service: "customer-quotas"
```

Priya Radhakrishnan: Example SLO burn rule (copy for SRE review):
```yaml
- name: "slo-burn-fast"
  expr: slo_error_budget_burn_rate[5m] > 5
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: P0
    pd_service: "runtime-core-pager"
```

Maya Patel: Action items:
- @Sean add windowed metric queries + any missing labels by EOD tomorrow
- @Alex add quota metrics and PD service mapping
- @Priya draft final escalation doc and paste to PR
- @Jess add rollout UX controls to the console ticket

Maya Patel: tagging owners on the PR now. If no objections I'll merge the dashboard and we can start canarying alerts next week. :+1:
